hook.text: What does a musical interval look like?

text.formula: Slightly out of tune: it spirals

youtube.title: Pendulums draw musical intervals ✍️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Two swinging pendulums move a pen. Their frequency ratio, 2:1 or 3:2, decides the shape; a tiny detune makes it rotate and spiral.

hook.text: What shape do Venus and Earth draw?

text.formula: Venus and Earth, 13 to 8: a flower

youtube.title: Venus and Earth draw a five-petal flower 🪐 #shorts
youtube.description:
Draw a line between two planets every few days. Venus goes round the Sun 13 times while Earth goes 8 times, and the lines make a five-petal flower.

youtube.title: Times tables draw hearts on a circle ❤️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Put 200 points on a circle and join point n to point 2n. A heart shape appears: the cardioid. ×3 makes a nephroid, and higher tables add more petals.

hook.text: What does a wheel in a wheel draw?

text.formula: Half-size wheel, pen on the rim: a straight line!
Pen inside the wheel: a star of loops
A quarter wheel: a four-point star

youtube.title: A wheel inside a wheel draws stars 🌀 #shorts
youtube.description:
A small wheel rolls inside a big one with a pen on it. The ratio of the two sizes decides how many loops the curve has.
